comments.text: @netbird Passing raw keys to agents that execute arbitrary code... what could go wrong. This should have been solved a year ago.

comments.name: FinWizz
comments.text: @netbird netbird gives agents their own identity layer. We see this as key for onboarding the next wave of users who want to query markets without exposing full keys.

comments.name: Davtheultimate
comments.text: @netbird Enfin une solution concrète. Les API keys en libre-service = faille de sécurité + coûts explosifs. NetBird ajoute une couche d’IAM légère, c’est le minimum syndical pour scaler sans se faire plumer. À tester en urgence.

comments.text: @netbird I dont see the biggest upside in the world to putting my API keys into one spot into anyone elses database. If you get breached I gotta solve all that.
